title: John Rutter - The Lord Bless You & Keep You

lines.l: Ideal music to distract us from the wet and windy outdoors.
John Rutt is the law, bless you and keep you.
That was the highest climber on this year's Classic FM Hall of Fame.
And before it, De Pucey's On Bateau, we heard.
If you've got another hour in you,
plenty more of the most relaxing music with me,
a Haydn violin concerto, some Foray,
Inaudi and Paul Simon as well.
One of those must be playing your tune.
Get in touch for a mention or a dedication.
Tell me your favourite composer and I'll see what I can do.
